opened.text: When one ground of a decision fails, anyone can reproduce what loses standing, what still holds through other grounds, and the path to each.
minds' documents are projections of records: nothing that checks a claim parses Markdown.
Every normative claim of VARS-1 is held by a witness and burned by a mutant, or says plainly that it is not.
The live chain changes its rules under evidence, verified on more than one host.
Rules v2 can be activated without leaving a reader or a reference unaccounted for.

residual: a goal proves nothing: it sets the direction of path search; it is shown met only by a superseding transition that establishes it
